name: bevy
description: Authoritative idioms for Bevy 0.20 game projects in Rust. Covers ECS data design (incl. resources-as-components), communication (Event/Message/Observer), plugin organization, scheduling, assets, UI (text, widgets, text input), BSN scenes, rendering (WESL shaders), error handling, testing, performance, and 0.16→0.20 migration.
